<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F8FCFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="18" y="19" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="16" x2="326" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="16" x2="331" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="16" x2="336" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="16" x2="341" y2="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="354" cy="13" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="354" y1="8" x2="354" y2="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="7" width="19" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367" y="9" width="14" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#15451F"/>
    <rect x="384" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="31,59 22,59 29,52" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="59" x2="38" y2="59" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Plan your trip</text>
    <circle cx="358" cy="58" r="15" fill="#FFEF8F"/>
    <polygon points="358,48 361,55 368,55 363,60 365,67 358,63 351,67 353,60 348,55 355,55" fill="#FFC800"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Multi-step progress -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="104" width="350" height="10" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="20" y="104" width="117" height="10" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <circle cx="20" cy="109" r="7" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <circle cx="137" cy="109" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="253" cy="109" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="370" cy="109" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="20" y="132" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#00A47D">DESTINATION</text>
    <text x="137" y="132" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">DATES</text>
    <text x="253" y="132" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">GOALS</text>
    <text x="370" y="132" text-anchor="end" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">READY</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main heading -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="175" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Where are you going?</text>
    <text x="20" y="201" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">We’ll tailor your lessons to the places you’ll visit.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Destination field -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="237" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Destination</text>
    <rect x="20" y="247" width="350" height="60" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.45"/>
    <rect x="20" y="245" width="350" height="60" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- French flag -->
    <rect x="36" y="258" width="13" height="34" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <rect x="49" y="258" width="13" height="34" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="62" y="258" width="13" height="34" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <text x="88" y="269" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">COUNTRY</text>
    <text x="88" y="290" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">France</text>
    <polyline points="342,270 350,278 358,270" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="20" y="326" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Your lessons will include useful French for this trip.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Suggested destinations -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="366" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Choose a destination</text>
    <text x="370" y="366" text-anchor="end" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">See all</text>
    
    <rect x="20" y="380" width="350" height="70" rx="14" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.4"/>
    <rect x="20" y="378" width="350" height="70" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="35" y="393" width="45" height="34" rx="8" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <rect x="35" y="393" width="15" height="34" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <rect x="50" y="393" width="15" height="34" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="65" y="393" width="15" height="34" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <text x="96" y="407" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Paris, France</text>
    <text x="96" y="428" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" fill="#6F6F70">Most popular destination</text>
    <circle cx="345" cy="413" r="12" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <polyline points="339,413 343,417 351,408" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    
    <rect x="20" y="459" width="168" height="61" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="37" y="484" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Lyon</text>
    <text x="37" y="505" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" fill="#6F6F70">France</text>
    <rect x="204" y="459" width="166" height="61" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="221" y="484" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Nice</text>
    <text x="221" y="505" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" fill="#6F6F70">France</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Trip preview card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="536" width="350" height="100" rx="14" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.45"/>
    <rect x="20" y="534" width="350" height="100" rx="14" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="567" r="20" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="570" x2="61" y2="570" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="48,561 43,570 48,579" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="56,561 61,570 56,579" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="86" y="563" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Your French trip</text>
    <text x="86" y="586" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" fill="#456B64">Paris · cafés · getting around</text>
    <rect x="86" y="600" width="111" height="22" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="141" y="615" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">Personalized</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="666" width="350" height="50" rx="13" fill="#15451F" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="20" y="663" width="350" height="50" rx="13" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <text x="195" y="695" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
    <polyline points="278,687 284,693 278,699" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="739" width="390" height="105" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="739" x2="374" y2="739" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="45,763 57,753 69,763" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="49" y="762" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="57" y="796" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Learn active -->
    <g>
      <rect x="128" y="750" width="40" height="34" rx="8" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="137" y="758" width="21" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="140" y1="763" x2="155" y2="763" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="140" y1="768" x2="151" y2="768" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="148" y="796" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">Learn</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Practice -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="240" cy="767" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="234,768 239,773 247,762" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="240" y="796" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Practice</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="329" cy="761" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="329" cy="776" rx="12" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="329" y="796" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
